t: The Magnusson Bar Clamp Set delivers reliable clamping and spreading performance for woodworking, construction, and general diy applications. Built with a strong carbon steel bar, each clamp provides excellent durability and high gripping force, making them suitable for demanding trade use as well as home projects. Designed for one-handed operation for ease & efficiency, the clamps allow secure, quick adjustment and release of workpieces without interrupting workflow, while the quick-release trigger enables fast tool-free switching between clamping and spreading functions. A plastic TPR handle provides a secure, non-slip and comfortable grip during extended use, and soft plastic jaw guards help protect delicate work surfaces from marks and damage. The set includes 2 x 6" (150mm) bar clamps and 2 x 12" (300mm) bar clamps, offering a versatile range of sizes for handling both small, precise tasks and larger, more demanding applications.
